A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the parameters of RAPN,RPR,RGSR and RGYPP were more reliable and effective in screening of upland rice germoplasm than those of the parameters of RSW,RTW,RTN and RPW at the seedling stages.
RAPN and RGYPP could be the best parameters for screening of upland rice germ-plasm with soil P efficiency.
RSW and RTN are reliable parameters for screening soil P efficient uplands at the seedling stages,and RTN,RAP and RPW are reliable and effective for screening at the whole life cycle.
The main takeaway from our work is that

soil phosphorus efficiency of the upland rices is a complex trait,which is influenced by many genetic and environmental factors,and that the screening of soil phosphorus efficient upland rice can be carried out on the substrate of P deficient soils in the seedling stage and in the course of whole life cycle of rice germplasms.
BXLD and RD-128 can be used as germplasm resources to improve the soil P efficiency of rice.
BXLD and QX128 can be used as parents in hybrid breeding to develop high yielding and soil P efficient varieties.
